brief:
# Build: console-wake (Urgent profile)

Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice). GO given. Assigned agent: **Ping Paulie** (book this run on his agent-swarm card: stats, cost, chat; set AXF_AGENT=ping-paulie or the equivalent if crew-retrain's launcher support is on main, otherwise record it in the report and the builds store note).

## Problem
Voice control of the Dev Console works through axHub -> axf-console MCP (console_open / console_action / console_dialog / console_settings, console-commands on main). But commands fail with `not_found: no console is open for you right now` whenever the browser tab isn't connected at that instant:
- Brett approved a held command from INSIDE the console; his client `cc-cq7hakm3a02p` dropped for ~2 s exactly as the approved call ran (failed 17:18:49, reconnected 17:18:51 UTC) and the command was lost.
- Console redeploys (Lenny's landings) and phone tab sleep drop the connection too.
- If the browser is closed, nothing can happen at all.

## Brett's rule
No matter what, a console command must reach a console: even if the browser is closed, open it.

## Steps
- s0 Register in Urgent via the orchestrator CLI (id `console-wake`) + banner entry.
- s1 Queue + deliver: console commands never fail just because no client is connected. The server queues the command (per user, short TTL, default 2 min, setting) and delivers it the moment a console client connects/reconnects; the MCP call waits (up to ~60 s) for delivery and returns 'delivered' / 'queued, waiting for the console'. Dedupe on reconnect so a command never runs twice. Find and fix why approving inside the console drops the websocket (approvals dialog re-render / page reload / ticket refresh) so it stops happening.
- s2 Wake via AmberX (Android, allowed: AmberX is the Android-hold exception): when a command is queued and no console client connects within ~3 s, the console server asks axHub to tell Brett's AmberX app (AXPP device connection, `amberx` service) to open https://console.amberxai.com in Chrome (Intent ACTION_VIEW to the default browser, Chrome preferred; deep link with `?axf-cmd=<id>` so the page picks the queued command right away). Works from background: use a high-priority notification with a full-screen/launch intent where Android blocks background activity starts (Android 10+ background activity limits), tap = open. Add the AXPP command to the AmberX app (Java, Capacitor shell) and the axHub device-relay side (axHub repo, separate PR) with an `amberx.open_url` tool restricted to Brett's own domains (amberxai.com allowlist).
- s3 Settings: Settings > Plugins > (console commands) 'Wake the console through AmberX when it's closed' (on by default), queue TTL, which browser.
- s4 Visibility: the console shows a brief toast 'Amber: opening Terminal' when a queued command runs; the MCP result says how it was delivered (live / after reconnect / woke via AmberX).
- s5 Tests (queue, TTL, dedupe, reconnect delivery, wake path with a fake device), axHub tests, AmberX JUnit for the URL allowlist; report `_claude/builds/reports/console-wake.md`; THREADS; PRs (AmberX-AXF + axHub). Mark steps done through the store.
Note: the new AmberX APK must be installed on Brett's phone for the wake path; put that on his checklist (/projects/_shared/_claude/notes/checklist-one.md) via the hub memory API. Commits clean and professional.

uiReview.name: Console commands: When no console is open

open: The queue is in memory. A console redeploy while a command waits drops it, and the waiting call dies with the server anyway.
Android 14+ limits full-screen intents to calling and alarm apps unless the user allows it. There it shows as a heads-up notification, and one tap opens the console.
Only the owner audience wakes a phone. Hub users' commands queue but never wake anything.
